sub.description: Member id (UUID). The only identifier apps may use to match members.

type.description: text | textarea | url | email | phone | date | select | tags. Unknown types: show 「請更新 app」.

candidate_id.description: Opaque, valid 1 hour; pass to POST /v1/me/spouse

duplicate_candidates.description: member_number only: other members with the same number (ask whether to bind as spouses)

rank.description: Shared reviewed rank label, or null

reason.description: Internal logging only; never show to members

min_rank.description: Rank code from GET /v1/amway/field-definitions; only with hglobal_verified

refresh_token.description: Replace the stored one every time; reusing an old one revokes the session.

get.summary: Health check
OpenID Provider discovery document
Public signing keys (JWKS)
Authorization endpoint (authorization code + PKCE S256)

schema.description: Space-separated; must include openid. Supported: openid profile profile.read profile.basic.write profile.avatar.write profile.contact.write profile.birthday.write profile.visibility.write profile.spouse.write amway.read amway.write

400.description: Unknown client or redirect_uri (HTML page, no redirect)

get.summary: UserInfo endpoint
RP-initiated logout (ends the central sign-in session for every app)
Profile field definitions (drives every app's profile page; cache up to 1 hour)
My profile (do not cache)

put.summary: Write one profile field (idempotent; null clears it). Scope depends on the field.

429.description: rate_limited (member_number: 3 self-service changes per 24 hours; see Retry-After)

put.summary: Set public/private per field (partial update). The avatar is always public.

post.summary: Upload a cropped square avatar (≤512 px, JPEG/PNG/WebP, ≤2 MB). Currently returns 501.

501.description: not_available (file storage is not enabled yet)

post.summary: Use my Google picture as avatar. Currently returns 501.

501.description: not_available (file storage is not enabled yet)

get.summary: My spouse binding (scope profile.spouse.write or profile.read)

post.summary: Bind as spouses (single-sided consent, effective at once). candidate_id comes from duplicate_candidates.

404.description: not_found (candidate unknown, expired, or no longer sharing a number)

delete.summary: Unbind. Rank stays; the member who started the binding gets a new random member number. Re-read the profile afterwards.

get.summary: Amway field definitions and option lists (cache up to 1 hour). Rank options are in ladder order.
Consent text (short version) and version. Render as given; never hard-code (cache up to 1 hour).
My Amway data and review status (do not cache)

put.summary: Turn 「我是Amway會員」 on (needs the current consent_version) or off (data kept, eligibility paused)
Write one Amway field. Reviewed fields stay pending (old value effective) until approved.

get.summary: My in-site notifications (latest 50)

post.summary: Does the signed-in member meet this rule? Treat any non-200 or timeout as not allowed. Cache ≤ 1 day.
Check up to 50 rules at once (list pages). Results are in the same order as the rules.

get.summary: My staff roles and permissions
Pending review requests (oldest first)

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending request (member is notified)

get.summary: Find members by member number, member id, or display name
Member detail for staff (numbers, Amway fields, spouse, roles)

put.summary: Adjust one of the six reviewed fields (treated as approved; member notified; audited)

get.summary: All Amway option lists, including inactive ones

put.summary: Create or update one option (rank sort_order = ladder position, low to high)

get.summary: Merge page: custom upline names typed by members, with counts

post.summary: Merge page: fold one custom upline name into an existing option for every member

get.summary: Staff and their roles

put.summary: Set a member's roles (super admin; needs a sign-in within 10 minutes)

get.summary: Open data deletion requests (due within 15 days of the request)

post.summary: Carry out a deletion request (account: anonymize and close; amway: remove Amway data). Needs a sign-in within 10 minutes.

get.summary: Audit log (newest first). Contains no tokens, secrets, names, emails or Amway values.
My data deletion requests (member site only)

post.summary: Ask for deletion of the Amway area data or the whole account (needs a sign-in within 10 minutes)
Cancel a request that has not been carried out yet
Get a single-use sign-in nonce (10 minutes, bound to the App)

200.description: Nonce. Send its SHA-256 (hex) to the sign-in relay and the raw value to POST /v1/auth/google.

post.summary: Sign in (or sign up) with the Google ID token returned by the sign-in relay
Rotate tokens; reusing an old refresh token revokes the session

200.description: New token pair; replace the stored refresh token

post.summary: End every session of the member: every App, every device and the member site

get.summary: Status, minimum version and public settings an App reads at launch
get.description: Show maintenance when status is paused, stop when killed, and require an update below min_version. Changes take effect within 30 seconds.

get.summary: Newest integration instructions for this App (super admin only, this App's own sign-in only)
get.description: Called by the App's own admin page. Send `integrated` (the instruction version the App was last built to); it is recorded. When up_to_date is false, patch ONLY the differences. Never contains keys.

get.summary: Registered Apps with statistics and integration-instruction versions

post.summary: Register a new App (blank platform fields are derived from the app_id). Apps cannot be deleted; use status killed.

put.summary: Edit an App registration (needs a sign-in within 10 minutes: it can change who may sign in)
Set an App to active, paused or killed (takes effect within 30 seconds)

get.summary: Integration instructions to paste to the AI that builds this App (public values only)
